tn.detailLevel: Detailed guide; verify latest government notice
verifiedFacts: The official Tamil Nadu budget for 2025–26 describes the scheme as ₹1,000 monthly assistance for eligible beneficiaries.
The official KMUT portal's basic criteria include an applicant aged 21 or older and family-head rules; it also describes income, agricultural-land and household-electricity limits, plus exclusions.

The KMUT guide gives threshold examples: annual family income below ₹2.5 lakh, wetland under 5 acres or dryland under 10 acres, and household electricity use below 3,600 units per year. The official eligibility page includes additional exclusions.
The official portal publishes scheme, eligibility and FAQ information. Registration windows and instructions can change; direct the user to the latest official notice.
guardrails: The guide's basic criteria are only an initial explanation, not a decision or approval.
Never ask the user to type Aadhaar, OTP, bank, phone or ration-card numbers.
Do not promise that registration is currently open.
